# Musubi Unreal plugin

`Musubi/` is a runtime plugin for Unreal Engine 5.3 → 5.8 (modules: Core, CoreUObject, Engine, Json,
HTTP, WebSockets). Copy it to `<Project>/Plugins/Musubi`, enable it, and add `"Musubi"` to your
module's dependencies. Design and compatibility policy: `docs/gdk-unreal.md`.

## Layers

**Wire** (`MusubiWire.generated.{h,cpp}`, generated by `cargo run -p musubi-unreal-gen` from
`crates/musubi-proto/src/{lib,realtime}.rs`): every client/server message as a struct with
`ToJson/FromJson` and postcard `Write/Read`, serde semantics mirrored (tags, int-repr enums as zigzag,
`json_in_binary` as JSON text, `pos_cm` as i32 centimetres, uuid with length prefix, renames and
default functions). `--check` fails CI when the protocol drifts; `tools/wire-test.sh` runs the golden
vectors from `crates/musubi-proto/tests/wire_vectors.rs` against the C++ codecs byte-for-byte.

**Transport**: `FMusubiClient` (REST: device/email auth, refresh with rotation, `Call(verb, path,
body)`), `FMusubiSocket` (typed `Send`/`Request` with `cid` correlation and timeouts, JSON or
postcard framing, LZ4 prefix, ping/RTT, backoff reconnect with an `OnResubscribe` hook, per-tag
delegates), `UMusubiSubsystem` (owns both, pumps the socket from `FTSTicker`).

**Facades** — one `UGameInstanceSubsystem` per protocol group, all on `UMusubiFacade` (lazy bind to
the socket, `Listen(tag)`, `Request` → typed reply or a local `unavailable` error when offline, replay
on reconnect). Each keeps a client-side cache, exposes C++ delegates and a Blueprint surface
(`UFUNCTION`s + dynamic delegates, `FMusubiCallResult` for async completions).

| Facade | Wire | Cache / replay |
|---|---|---|
| `UMusubiPresence` | `status_update`, `status_follow/unfollow` → `status`, `status_presence_event` | own status, followed accounts → online sessions; re-sends status + follows after reconnect |
| `UMusubiStorage` | `storage_subscribe/unsubscribe` → `storage_update` | last value per (collection,key,owner); resubscribes |
| `UMusubiRpc` | `rpc` → `rpc` | realtime when connected, falls back to `POST /v1/rpc/{id}` |
| `UMusubiNotifications` | `notification` + `GET/DELETE /v1/notifications`, `POST /v1/notifications/read` | inbox newest-first, unread count from the server; backfills on every (re)connect |
| `UMusubiChat` | `channel_join/leave`, `channel_message_send/update/remove`, `channel_typing` → `channel_message`, `channel_presence`, `channel_message_ack` | joined channels with presences and last 200 messages (codes 0/1/2 = message/updated/removed, negative = system, reactions merged); typing throttle; rejoins |
| `UMusubiMatchmaker` | `matchmaker_add/remove/ready`, `party_matchmaker_add/remove` → `matchmaker_ticket/expired/matched/ready_check/ready_failed` | tickets with state machine (queued → ready check → matched / expired / failed); re-queues solo tickets only when the session was not resumed |
| `UMusubiParties` | create/update/list/join/leave/promote/accept/remove/close/data/invite/join requests → `party`, `party_presence`, `party_leader`, `party_join_request`, `party_data`, `party_close`, `party_invite` | current party, join requests, leader; rejoins by id |
| `UMusubiMatches` | `match_create/join/leave/data_send/host_transfer` → `match`, `match_data`, `match_presence`, `match_host` | joined matches with members, host, frame counters; rejoins with the original args (token / spectator / delay) |
| `UMusubiStreams` | `stream_data` | per-stream watchers and frame counters |

**World view** (module `MusubiWorld`, `docs/gdk-unreal.md` §4) — `UMusubiWorldComponent` on the local pawn
or camera owner:

- *Interest driver*: `world_subscribe` from the owner's position, re-sent after moving `radius × 0.25`
  (or `ResubscribeDistance`) or every 5 s; `radius = max(ViewDistance, 2 × CellSize)`, budget, component
  filter, `max_hz` (default `min(fps, 30)`), `inside` via `OpenContainer/CloseContainer`.
- *Registry*: `TMap<FMusubiUuid, FMusubiEntityRecord>`; a delta applies despawned → spawned → updated;
  a spawn for a known id is a re-sync; an update for an unknown id waits `UnknownUpdateGraceTicks` for
  its spawn; sequenced (unreliable) frames apply only when newer than everything applied and never
  spawn/despawn; a component with `version <= known` is ignored (handover re-sends).
- *Interpolation*: a playback clock in authoritative ticks runs `DeltaTime × TickHz × time_scale`
  (`TickHz` measured from the deltas), renders `InterpolationDelayTicks` behind, extrapolates at most
  one tick; `OnTimeScaleChanged` for a dilation indicator. Position = wire `x, y` (cm) + height from
  the `z` component, yaw from the `yaw` component or the movement direction.
- *Sinks*: `UMusubiEntityMapping` asset (first matching rule: `component [== value] → actor class |
  instanced mesh | none`). Actors are pooled per class (`PoolSize`) and carry a `UMusubiEntityComponent`
  (components as JSON, `OnComponentChanged`, `OnEntityReady`, `OnEntityDespawned`); instanced entities go
  to one `UInstancedStaticMeshComponent` per mesh with a free-list of slots and one
  `BatchUpdateInstancesTransforms` per frame.
- *Reconnect*: the node starts a fresh interest, so the registry is marked stale and whatever the
  keyframe does not mention within `ReconnectOrphanGraceSec` is despawned. *Bandwidth guard*: radius
  shrinks ×0.8 while late/lost frames stay above `GuardLateFramesPerSec` for 3 s, grows back ×1.1/s.
- `SetLocalEntity(id)` + `SendInput(json)` for the player's own entity (prediction/reconcile buffer
  comes with rollback matches, §5). `OnStats` once a second: entities, actors, instances, deltas/s,
  sequenced/s, late/s, tick rate, time scale, radius.

**Server module** (`MusubiServer`, `docs/gdk-unreal.md` §6) — a dedicated-server build of the project as a
Musubi simulator (the engine owns physics, Musubi owns authority and meshing):

- `MusubiSimWire.generated.{h,cpp}`: the simulator stream types generated from `crates/musubi-mesh`
  (`SimFrame`/`CellFrame`, every `SimEvent`, `SimCommand`, results) with golden vectors
  (`tools/sim-wire-test.sh`, 40 fixtures from `musubi-mesh/tests/sim_wire_vectors.rs`).
- `FMusubiSimStream`: one WebSocket to `GET /v1/server/worlds/{w}/stream?sim=&delta=1` with the fleet key,
  commands with echoed ids, backoff reconnect.
- `UMusubiSimulatorSubsystem`: starts on a dedicated server from `UMusubiSimulatorSettings`
  (`[/Script/MusubiServer.MusubiSimulatorSettings]`; `MUSUBI_API/_WORLD/_SERVER_KEY` and `-MusubiApi= -MusubiWorld=
  -MusubiKey= -MusubiCells=0,0;1,0` override). Ticks at `Hz` from the core ticker: frames → owned actors
  (authoritative, `CustomTimeDilation` follows the cell's `time_scale`) and ghosts (kinematic); changed owned
  actors → `apply`; `tick_done` closes the tick and renews the lease (lost/new cells surface as cell events).
  Handover: request → `CanRelease` → final `apply` with velocity → `handover_ack` → frozen until completed;
  arrival restores velocity and replays buffered inputs. Inputs/interactions reach the actor's
  `UMusubiAuthorityComponent` (`ApplyInput`, `OnInteraction`, `CanRelease` as BlueprintNativeEvents;
  `SetComponent*` marks dirty for the next `apply`; `Interact`, `RequestDespawn`). Project hook
  `SpawnEntityActor` picks the actor class per entity; otherwise the settings' classes.
- Not yet: cell → level-streaming, Chaos deterministic-mode assertions, `rewind` driven snapshots
  (`rewind` is exposed as a command only).

**Rollback matches** (`UMusubiMatch`, §5) over `UMusubiMatches`: `Attach(matchId, tickRate)` (0 = measured
from the `match_tick_hash` cadence), `SendInput(opcode, bytes)` stamps the predicted tick (server tick
estimate + `ceil(rtt/2 / tick_ms) + 1`) and keeps it in a ring until the `match_input_ack` with its `seq`;
`applied == false` → `LateInputs` + `OnInputRejected`. `HashTick` hook (FNV-1a 64 helper with the node's
constants — hash the same bytes your handler hashes) is compared with every `match_tick_hash`; mismatch →
`OnDesync`, and with `DesyncPolicy = Rejoin` the match is left and re-joined for a fresh keyframe (there is no
"send keyframe" message). The synced state is mirrored from `match_state` and patched by `match_state_delta`
(RFC 6902: `MusubiJsonPatch`), readable as JSON or by pointer from Blueprint.

## Iris bridge — module `MusubiIris` (tier B: UE 5.5–5.8)

Compiles to an empty stub on 5.3/5.4 (`MUSUBI_WITH_IRIS=0`, gate = engine version; 5.7 UBT's `SetupIrisSupport()` is unconditional, there is no per-target Iris switch). The bridge/factory sources live in `Source/MusubiIrisImpl` (not a module) and are attached to `MusubiIris` with `ConditionalAddModuleDirectory` on 5.5+ only: UHT does not evaluate `#if MUSUBI_WITH_IRIS` around a base class (it drops the whole `#if/#else/#endif`, leaving `Super` undefined — seen with UE 5.3.2 UBT), so the classes must not be visible to it on tier A at all. On 5.5+:

- `UMusubiReplicationBridge : UObjectReplicationBridge` — Iris keeps owning dirty tracking and descriptors. The bridge tracks objects that carry a `UMusubiAuthorityComponent` from `CacheNetRefHandleCreationInfo` (the one hook both 5.7 and 5.8 call when an object starts replicating), and in `PreSendUpdate` serializes their replicated `UPROPERTY`s (plus replicated components, `Comp.Prop` keys) to JSON, hash-gated (FNV-1a 64), into the entity component `iris` — the simulator subsystem ships it as `apply` on the next `tick_done`. Ghosts are never mirrored back. Detach from Iris = `RequestDespawn` for owned entities: 5.7 via the `DetachInstance` override; 5.8 removed the virtual and its detach delegates are private to the engine, so the bridge sweeps tracked handles whose `GetReplicatedObject()` is null at the start of each send update. `OnProtocolMismatchReported` has the 5.8 `ClientCDOStateBytes` signature behind `ENGINE_MINOR_VERSION >= 8`.
- `UMusubiNetObjectFactory : UNetObjectFactory`, registered as `MusubiEntity` at module startup (`PostConfigInit`). Creation header = class path + entity uuid + actor flag; remote instantiation spawns the class deferred, `PostInstantiation` binds the authority component as a ghost (`Bind(sim, uuid, cell, owned=false)`) and finishes spawning; `DetachedFromReplication` destroys the actor unless Iris says `DoNotDestroy`.

**Mass sink** (`MusubiMass`, §3/§6): mapping rules with `Sink = Mass` get no actor; `UMusubiMassSinkComponent`
(same actor as the world component, or `World` set) creates one Mass entity per record — archetype
`FTransformFragment + FMusubiEntityFragment{IdHi, IdLo, LastTick, ComponentsRevision, bLocal} + FMusubiEntityTag` —
writes the interpolated transform every frame (ticks after the world component), bumps `ComponentsRevision` when
any component version changed, destroys on despawn / registry reset. `OnMassEntityCreated(Manager, Handle, Record)`
is where a project adds its own fragments; `FindMassEntity` / `FindRecordId` map both ways. Plugin dependency
`MassGameplay` (brings `MassEntity` on 5.3/5.4; from 5.5 MassEntity is an engine module).

**Transport** (`MusubiTransport.h`, §8): `FMusubiSocket` runs over an `IMusubiTransport`. `FMusubiWsTransport`
(engine `IWebSocket`, token/format/resume in the `/ws` query) ships in the core module; the `MusubiQuic` module
registers `FMusubiQuicTransport` on top of `crates/musubi-quic-ffi` — a Rust static library (quinn + rustls, the
node's own QUIC stack) with a five-call C ABI (`musubi_quic.h`: `mq_connect / mq_send / mq_poll / mq_max_datagram /
mq_close`), built per platform by `tools/build-quic-ffi.sh` into `Source/ThirdParty/MusubiQuicFfi/lib/<Platform>/`.
No library for the platform → the module compiles to a stub and the plugin stays WebSocket-only.

## Engine networking through the node — module `MusubiNet` (phase 9b)

`UMusubiNetDriver` / `UMusubiNetConnection` carry the engine's own game connection (`UNetDriver` packets,
replication Iris or classic, RPCs, login) through the node instead of a UDP socket, so the engine's
replication code is untouched and the node decides which simulator a client talks to. Client URL
`musubi://<world>?entity=<uuid>`: the driver asks the node for a relay on the entity (`net_open`), every packet
is a `net_packet` the node routes to the entity's current owner (buffered while it is in transit); a dedicated
server with `UMusubiSimulatorSubsystem` running accepts connections from `net_packet` events (first packet on
an unknown conn opens one — `UIpNetDriver` semantics, no stateless challenge: the node already authenticated
the session). When the entity hands over, the node closes the old owner's side and sends the client
`net_rehome`; v1 answers it with a reconnect to the same URL (`UMusubiNetDriver::OnRehome`, overridable) — the
in-place restart with actor adoption is the next step. `max_packet` 1200 B; conn ids stay below 2^53 because
engines parse JSON numbers as doubles. Enable with
`+NetDriverDefinitions=(DefName="GameNetDriver",DriverClassName="/Script/MusubiNet.MusubiNetDriver",DriverClassNameFallback="/Script/OnlineSubsystemUtils.IpNetDriver",bCanUseIris=true)`.
Built by real UBT on 5.8.4 (classic `UNetDriver` API only, so it is tier-independent). Design: `docs/gdk-unreal.md` §9.

- Wire: ALPN `musubi-rt/1`; the first bidi stream carries the `hello` text frame (`{token, format, resumable,
  resume}`) and then envelopes framed `[type u8][len u32 BE][body]`; binary frames sent with `bUnreliable` travel as
  datagrams `[type u8][body]` when they fit. Layout is pinned to the node by `musubi-quic-ffi/tests/parity.rs`.
- `FConfig::Transport = Auto` picks QUIC when registered and falls back to WebSocket if QUIC fails before its first
  handshake; `QuicPort` is the node's `quic.listen` UDP port (0 = API port), `bQuicInsecure` (or an `http://` base)
  accepts self-signed dev certificates. `bResumable` (default on) makes reconnects resume the parked session.
- The ffi owns one tokio thread per connection; the transport polls it from the game thread (≤ 512 events/tick).


**Latent Blueprint nodes** (`UMusubiAsyncAction`): every facade request that takes a callback also exists as an
async node with `On Done` / `On Failed` pins carrying the same `FMusubiCallResult` — Join Room / Direct / Group,
Send Chat Text / JSON, Subscribe Storage, Refresh Inbox, Follow Accounts, Matchmaker Enqueue, Create / Join Party,
Create / Join Match (by id or token), Call RPC. The node holds itself alive via `RegisterWithGameInstance` until
the reply; a missing facade or game instance fails locally with `unavailable`.

**Settings**: Project Settings → Plugins → Musubi (`UMusubiSettings`, `[/Script/Musubi.MusubiSettings]` in
`DefaultGame.ini`): node address, wire encoding, transport (Auto/WebSocket/QUIC), QUIC port, insecure dev TLS,
resumable sessions, reply timeout, ping, backoff, inflight and frame limits. `UMusubiSubsystem` reads it at
Initialize (address → `Configure()`, the rest → `SocketConfig()` used by `ConnectSocket`); `-MusubiApi=<url>`
on the command line and a runtime `Configure()` override the address.

## Status / caveats

- Not yet: a demo map (needs the editor; the 10k meshbench world is the intended content), live WS→QUIC
  migration (Auto only decides at connect time), console platform builds of `musubi-quic-ffi`.
- The wire layer is compiled and tested in CI against `tools/ue-shim` (a minimal stand-in for
  Core/Json). The whole plugin (all modules, Editor + Game targets, Linux) is built by the real
  UBT/UAT `BuildPlugin` with `tools/ue-build.sh <ver>` inside Epic's `dev-slim` images — green with
  0 warnings on 5.3.2, 5.7.4 and 5.8.4. That runs locally, not in CI (the images are 12–22 GiB and
  need a GitHub account linked to Epic Games), so it is re-run by hand before a release;
  `tools/ue-package.sh <ver>...` then zips each build into a drop-in prebuilt plugin
  (`target/ue/Musubi-<plugin>-ue<major.minor>-<platforms>.zip`: Binaries, generated headers, Source,
  `.uplugin` pinned to that engine). A build error report from any other version/platform is still
  the most useful issue you can file.
